dedupe_keys.name: world bank lsms isa living standards measurement study integrated surveys on agriculture

description: Nationally representative panel household surveys with a strong focus on agriculture in sub-Saharan Africa. The World Bank page says the LSMS-ISA project designed and implemented multi-topic panel surveys with the national statistical offices of Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Malawi, Mali, Niger, Nigeria, Tanzania and Uganda, together with methodological research on better ways to collect agricultural data, such as objective measurements, with free downloadable methods notes and questionnaire modules on the page. Coverage is the eight listed countries, households followed over several waves. Caveats: the page read does not list waves, sample sizes or the licence of each survey. For simulation it gives household-level farm production, assets, income and shocks, to build agent-based models of how farm households cope with droughts, floods or market disruptions. A related catalogue record is the RHoMIS farm household survey data.
